structured_output.summary: This was a gap in the tests, not a bug in the game code: world.ts already gives only car 0 the armed/boostTicks values, but no test checked the AI racer views while the player was armed or boosting. So I changed no src code and added one new test, tests/sim/pickup-ai-views.test.ts. It runs Dust Bowl with 3 cars, all driven by their bots. Once the player has been armed for at least 30 ticks, it fires action once. On every tick it checks that racers.slice(1) all have armed === false and boostTicks === 0. It also checks that the boost was fired and that at least one tick had racers[0].armed true and one had racers[0].boostTicks > 0. Red/green: it passes on the current code. With world.ts:152 changed to `r.armed = p.armed` it fails ('tick 260: expected true to be false'). With :153 changed to `r.boostTicks = p.boostTicks` it fails ('tick 290: expected 90 to be +0'). I put world.ts back after each mutation and confirmed with diff that it is unchanged. pnpm typecheck passes and pnpm test passes (112 files, 746 tests).
